version_note: Wiki patch pages end at Patch 1.1.2.0. News coverage reports game version 1.1.15 ('All Pain No Gain', 13 May 2026). This list may predate later stat changes; verify in-game before relying on it.
caveat: Summarising fetch of the rendered page. Names and effects as stated; the page gives no default values.

primary.name: Max HP
primary.effect: damage you can take before dying

primary.name: HP Regeneration
primary.effect: heals 1 HP every n seconds; first point gives 0.20 HP/s, each further point adds 0.089 HP/s

primary.name: Life Steal
primary.effect: each attack has x% chance to heal 1 HP; triggers at most once per 0.1 s (max 10 HP/s); chance is added per weapon

primary.name: Damage
primary.effect: +1% all damage per point; does not affect Engineering structures

primary.name: Melee Damage
primary.effect: modifies base damage of melee-scaling weapons

primary.name: Ranged Damage
primary.effect: modifies base damage of ranged-scaling weapons

primary.name: Elemental Damage
primary.effect: modifies base damage of elemental-scaling weapons

primary.name: Attack Speed
primary.effect: +x% attack rate, including ranged weapons (not structures); diminishing returns

primary.name: Crit Chance
primary.limit: max 100% on a hit; min 0% total

primary.name: Engineering
primary.effect: boosts structure power (not other stats; specials still apply)

primary.name: Luck
primary.effect: +x% item/consumable drop chance and better shop/level-up rarity

primary.name: Harvesting
primary.effect: earn x materials and XP per wave, growing 5% per activation (rounded up)

dlc_primary.name: Curse
dlc_primary.effect: enemies may spawn cursed (+25% damage, +15% speed, +150% HP, +2% HP per Curse point, 33% extra materials); shop items may gain curse buffs; cannot be negative
dlc_primary.limit: caps: 50% cursed enemies, 15% cursed items; HP scaling maxes at 300 Curse

secondary.name: % Materials Healing
secondary.effect: chance to heal 1 HP on picking up materials (Cute Monkey only)

secondary.name: % Pickup Range
secondary.effect: changes range for picking up materials and consumables

secondary.name: % Piercing Damage
secondary.effect: changes piercing damage falloff for projectiles

secondary.name: % Damage against Bosses
secondary.effect: multiplies damage vs Bosses and Elites

secondary.name: % Structure Attack Speed
secondary.effect: changes turret fire rate, Landmine spawns, and Garden consumable spawns

secondary.name: % Double Material Chance
secondary.effect: chance to gain double materials on pickup

secondary.name: Free Rerolls
secondary.effect: free rerolls at the start of each shop

secondary.name: % Reroll Price
secondary.effect: changes reroll cost in shop and upgrades
